Distribution. China (Fujian, Xizang, Yunnan); Japan and Vietnam. Notes. Scolia (Carinoscolia) yunnanensis tibetensis Betrem was reported as a subspecies of C. yunnanensis Betrem, 1941. Betrem (1941) mentioned some differences between them: only T 3 with yellowish brown spots, metasoma with blue reflections, wings brownish, but not dark, with golden reflections and carina on frons indistinct, S 2 with a distinct tubercle in C. tibetensis. We did not have the chance to examine the specimen from Tibet, but we found a female of C. yunnanensis (det. Betrem, 1967) in RMNH from Fujian, which has the characters of C. tibetensis displayed above, to be conspecific with specimens of nominate C. yunnanensis; both shared some characters of C. tibetensis and, therefore, we synonymize both subspecies.
